name: crvUSD
oneLiner: crvUSD is Curve's decentralized stablecoin minted against crypto collateral with LLAMMA soft-liquidation that arbitrages collateral instead of liquidating it.
collateral: WBTC, cbBTC (majority), wstETH, sfrxETH, weETH, tBTC, and ETH deposited as collateral; LLAMMA (Lending-Liquidating AMM) performs soft liquidations; WBTC/cbBTC custody by BitGo/Coinbase introduces centralized dependency
pegMechanism: Peg Stability Reserve (PegKeeper) contracts deposit or withdraw pre-minted crvUSD into Curve pools paired with USDC, USDT, PYUSD, frxUSD, and GHO to restore the peg; borrow rate adjusts dynamically — rising when crvUSD trades below $1 to incentivize repayments

oracleRisk.summary: Nine debt-bearing Ethereum controllers use market-specific Curve EMA and aggregate-stable-price routes. Modern Chainlink clamps were disabled at the reviewed block, while legacy sfrxETH requires an unchecked Chainlink answer; tBTC, weETH, cbBTC, and LBTC add single-pool conversion dependencies without alternate feeds. Per-branch debt shares (debtSharePct) were read from the Curve crvUSD markets API at Ethereum block 25584850 (2026-07-22); the current sfrxETH controller's share was not resolved in that read and is treated as material.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: ControllerFactory reported nine collateral controllers at finalized Ethereum block 25531477, and every controller had both positive total_debt and at least one active loan. Legacy sfrxETH and LBTC had zero debt ceilings but retained debt and loans, so they remain liquidation-active branches rather than exclusions.

branches.summary: At finalized Ethereum block 25584850 the legacy sfrxETH controller retained five loans and 153,839.980440801457521311 crvUSD of debt despite its closed debt ceiling; its oracle always invokes an unchecked Chainlink ETH/USD clamp and a 900-second Uniswap lower floor around Curve EMA components.

branches.fallbackBehavior: There is no alternate provider. Chainlink ETH/USD is called unconditionally for a plus-or-minus 1% clamp but updatedAt is not checked; the 900-second Uniswap frxETH/FRAX TWAP is only a lower floor, not failover. Mandatory component reverts block the oracle, and the internal Curve price uses a 600-second EMA.

collateralParameters.note: Controller 0x8472A9A7632b173c8Cf3a86D3afec50c35548e76; AMM 0x136e783846ef68C8Bd00a3369F787dF8d683a696; A=100, loan discount 9%, liquidation discount 6%. At finalized block 25584850, debt was 153,839.980440801457521311 crvUSD across five loans; zero ceiling disables fresh factory inventory but does not remove existing exposure.

branches.liquidationMechanism: LLAMMA band arbitrage performs permissionless soft liquidation as collateral price moves. Hard liquidation is permissionless when health(user, true) is below zero; a borrower or approved caller can invoke it earlier. The controller uses crvUSD already held in the AMM first, then requires the liquidator or callback to atomically supply any shortfall before collateral is transferred and debt is reduced.
branches.backstop: There is no Stability Pool, insurance fund, protocol bad-debt buyer, or committed auction backstop. LLAMMA inventory is used first and an external liquidator must provide the remaining crvUSD.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Recorded debt decreases only after the liquidation amount is fully covered. If liquidation is unavailable or uneconomic, the unhealthy loan remains open; the reviewed controller and factory define no global shutdown, settlement, write-off, or debt-socialization path.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648407 and Arbitrum block 489423259. Canonical Ethereum crvUSD 0xf939e0a03fb07f59a73314e73794be0e57ac1b4e is a non-proxy Vyper deployment (EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots zero). Runtime bytecode has no blacklist, isBlacklisted, freeze, pause, or paused selectors; minter() returns ControllerFactory 0xc9332fdcb1c491dcc683bae86fe3cb70360738bc; only burn(uint256)/mint paths appear (self-burn and minter mint). Official Stablecoin.vy transfer/transferFrom call unrestricted _transfer; burn is msg.sender-only and burnFrom is allowance-gated, with no holder deny-list. Material Arbitrum representation 0x498bf2b1e120fed3ad3d42ea2165e9b73f99c1e5 likewise lacks freeze/blacklist/pause selectors (bridge mint/burn surface only). Prior bridge-control inventory (OmniBridge/PoS/L2StandardBridge/Sonic Gateway/LayerZero) remains bridge-domain risk, not a current holder freeze. Failure domain: contract:ethereum:0xf939e0a03fb07f59a73314e73794be0e57ac1b4e under Curve minter authority for supply only. Collateral issuer freezes (WBTC/cbBTC) are backing exposure, not token-level blacklistability.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Grok T49 Safety Score V9 access review
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Suppression recorded 2026-07-31. LLAMMA collateral includes custodied WBTC and cbBTC, and PegKeeper pools pair crvUSD against USDC, USDT, PYUSD, and frxUSD; BitGo, Coinbase, Circle, or Tether can freeze those balances and impair collateral value or peg-arbitrage liquidity. None of those issuers has a function over the crvUSD ERC-20, which carries no blacklist, freeze, or pause selector on the reviewed Ethereum and Arbitrum deployments. Those exposures remain reserve-quality and dependency risks, not crvUSD blacklistability.

mintAuthority.summary: crvUSD's immutable ControllerFactory is the token minter and pre-mints inventory to each lending controller up to its debt ceiling. Curve DAO can raise those ceilings through an immutable Vyper intermediary; a 5-of-9 emergency multisig can only reduce ceilings and adjust controller parameters.

controls.label: crvUSD ControllerFactory
controls.capDescription: The factory mints crvUSD inventory to each controller only when an admin-set market debt ceiling is created or raised; user borrowing remains bounded by that inventory and the controller's collateral checks.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, crvUSD.minter() returned the ControllerFactory and ControllerFactory.admin() returned 0xb7400D2EA0f6DC1d7b153aA430B9E572F28afB79. Verified factory source shows _set_debt_ceiling() calls STABLECOIN.mint() only for the increase over residual inventory. Token and factory EIP-1967 slots are unset.

controls.label: Curve DAO Agent for crvUSD factory
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, the immutable Vyper factory-admin contract's dao() is this Curve DAO Aragon Agent. Verified intermediary source restricts execute(), factory ownership transfer, and emergency replacement to dao(), allowing DAO governance to call factory set_debt_ceiling() and raise market inventory. Blockscout identifies the Agent as an AppProxyUpgradeable with implementation 0x3A93C17FC82CC33420d1809dDA9Fb715cc89dd37.

controls.label: crvUSD emergency multisig
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, getThreshold() returned 5, getOwners() returned nine owners, and getModulesPaginated() returned no enabled modules. The intermediary's verified reduce_debt_ceiling() function accepts the emergency address but asserts the new ceiling cannot exceed the current ceiling; arbitrary execute() remains DAO-only.

review.evidence: Ethereum RPC at block 25530324 and verified Vyper source establish the full mint path: immutable token minter -> immutable ControllerFactory -> per-market debt-ceiling inventory. Factory admin is the immutable intermediary at 0xb740..., whose DAO path can raise ceilings while its 5-of-9 emergency path can only reduce them or change bounded controller parameters. The DAO Agent is upgradeable, but it is an upstream governance executor and cannot change the immutable token or factory mint logic.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
reserveReview.rationale: The prior per-market debt-share rows (WBTC, wstETH, tBTC, WETH, sfrxETH, cbBTC, weETH) never matched the live crvusd reserve adapter, which buckets on-chain LLAMMA band balances plus the Yield Basis collateral leg into four canonical exposures, so the v9 classification overlay could not attach. The envelope is restated on the adapter's exact bucket identities and 2026-07-19 captured weights; the adapter refreshes weights at runtime and each bucket now carries a complete failure-domain identity. PegKeeper counterassets remain stabilization-pool counterparties, not proportional collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live crvusd reserve adapter bucket identities and weights captured 2026-07-19 from Curve ControllerFactory/LLAMMA band balances and the Yield Basis on-chain collateral leg
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All four live collateral buckets are identified; per-market constituents inside each bucket (e.g. WBTC vs cbBTC vs LBTC) change with market usage and are aggregated by design.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held non-custodially in per-market LLAMMA AMM contracts and Yield Basis market contracts, with WBTC/cbBTC and tBTC introducing their own custodian and bridge layers. There is no issuer bankruptcy estate for the on-chain collateral itself, but wrapper-level custody, legal segregation, and reuse terms sit with the wrapper issuers and are not established by the reviewed sources.
